notes.title: Rifle Range High Score Challenge
notes.content:
To celebrate the launch of the new in-game rifle range, we're hosting a competition to see who can get the highest scores. All you need to do to participate is make sure you update to the latest version of the game, enter "The Range" from the menu, and start shooting! The top 3 scores at the end of the week (12/20 11:59PM EST) will receive the following prizes:

[list]
[b][*]First Prize: $60 SteamVR Game of Your Choice
[*]Second Prize: $20 SteamVR Game of Your Choice
[*]Third Prize: $10 SteamVR Game of Your Choice[/b]
[/list]
Additional Rules:
Scores must be a minimum of 39 or higher. In the event of a tie, the first player to record the score wins. You must have a valid e-mail address associated with your account in order to be eligible. All prices are in U.S. Dollars.

notes.title: A.I. Has Arrived
notes.content: With the latest update you can now fight against waves of A.I. controlled outlaws while you wait for an opponent! To get started simply join a quick match, and if an opponent isn't available right away, you'll face off against that A.I. until one is found. Combat against the A.I. incorporates the same great bullet-time mechanics as the multiplayer, but with some slight adjustments.

notes.title: Play Against The Developer
notes.content: This is your opportunity to play live against the developer across all 4 of the game's maps (including the newest addition). To participate simply launch the game and select quick-match mode. While you play, feel free to ask any questions regarding the game's development and future roadmap. Hope to see you there!

notes.title: War Yards Steam Game Festival Demo
notes.content:
[img]https://www.waryards.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/screen_2560x1440_2020-09-17_22-35-44.png[/img]
This demo represents an early version of the PvP functionality that the release version of War Yards will include. I chose this aspect of the game to demo because it most effectively showcases the game's unique multiplayer bullet-time mechanics. By allowing players to put their opponents projectiles into bullet-time, the game creates extremely tense and strategic matches that test players reflexes as well as their intellect. Feel free to join a quick match, or [url=https://discord.gg/cEezgFB]join us on Discord[/url] for help finding an opponent.

notes.title: Steam Game Festival Developer Livestream/Q&A
notes.content: As part of the Steam Game Festival, I will be doing an in-game livestream and Q&A. Anyone who wants to participate can simply join a quick match during the specified hours. While we battle in-game, I'll be answering any questions players might have about the development, functionality, or future of the game. I look forward to seeing you there!
